sources.title: Das Auto im Wandel der Mode
sources.creator: Frank Arnau
sources.researchNote: The photograph on p. 46 is captioned “Der neue »Adler-Standard 6« im Defu-Film »Ritter der Nacht« (Ruth Rickelt, Regisseur Max Reichmann, Wilhelm Dieterle)”. It belongs to an article on changing motoring fashion, not to the film press: the subject is the car, and the film unit is what surrounds it. It shows Reichmann at work in 1928, three years before the film he directed to music by Kaper and Jurmann. The caption names three of the four people standing by the car; the young man on the left is not identified. No photographer is named anywhere on the page.

media.title: Max Reichmann on location for Ritter der Nacht — Das Leben, September 1928
media.description: Photograph published in the illustrated magazine Das Leben in September 1928 to show a new Adler-Standard 6 touring car, with the people of the Defu film Ritter der Nacht standing beside it in a sunlit street: the actress Ruth Rickelt, the director Max Reichmann in shirtsleeves and Wilhelm Dieterle in a flat cap.
media.altText: Four people beside an open touring car in a sunlit street: a young man in a dark suit, a young woman in a cloche hat, a moustached man in shirtsleeves leaning on the wing, and a man in a flat cap and striped scarf.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. No photographer or agency is named in the magazine, which would make this an anonymous work published in 1928, but the digitising library applies the statement “Urheberrechtsschutz 1.0” to the whole volume. The local 908 × 668 pixel reproduction of the printed halftone is used for scholarly identification of a documented Kaper collaborator, with the holding institutions and the unresolved attribution stated alongside it.
